quote: I expected GTA VI to be something truly special, but after all those delays, I started having doubts about the game. Unfortunately, those doubts turned out to be **** game has several issues, and the story is extremely disappointing. Instead of focusing on crime, gangs, and the criminal underworld, which are a major part of what GTA is known for, the story seems to focus too much on a romantic **** top of that, the combat system looks far too similar to GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2, with very little that feels genuinely **** someone who has followed the GTA series for years, I’ve always expected every new installment to bring something significantly different from the previous one. This is why the overall experience feels like such a disappointment rather than the groundbreaking experience I **** excessive realism is another major problem. Household chores and grocery shopping just to keep Lucia happy? Seriously, are we playing GTA or a marriage simulator?The unnecessary restrictions also take away from the freedom that has always been one of GTA’s biggest strengths.After experiencing the game myself, I realized that critics don’t always tell the whole story.
